note: _timentis Dominum beata est anima eius_ – the one who fears the Lord – his soul is favoured. One would expect _timens_, but what we have here is a case of prolepsis or “left dislocation” from _beata est anima timentis Dominum_. – Bernard Bortolussi. Topicalizations, Left Dislocations and the Left Periphery. _Catalan Journal of Linguistics_ 16 (2017) 101–123.
